description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Talanoa Hufanga is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Hufanga will return for the first time since Week 5 for Denver.
items.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Charlie Kolar is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Kolar returned to a limited practice on Friday. His status remains up in the air heading into Sunday.
items.title: Charlie Kolar (concussion) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Daiyan Henley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Henley will be sidelined with a knee injury.
items.title: Daiyan Henley (knee) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ladd McConkey is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: McConkey was limited in practice all week. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.
items.title: Ladd McConkey (back) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Isaiah Likely is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Likely was unable to practice on Friday. He'll still be good to go on Sunday where he remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Isaiah Likely (groin) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Matt Gay is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Kansei Matsuzawa would likely be elevated if Gay is ruled out.
items.title: Matt Gay (hip) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rachaad White was limited in practice on Friday.
items.impact: White was added to the injury report. He was still able to practice in limited fashion.
items.title: Rachaad White (heel) limited in practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Treylon Burks did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Burks will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the Bengals.
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) misses practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zach Carter has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Carter has returned to practice. He won't be activated for Sunday.
items.title: Zach Carter (knee) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jon Gaines II has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Gaines did not practice on Thursday or Friday. He will be sidelined on Sunday.
items.title: Jon Gaines II (ankle) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Zack Baun (back) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Baun is going to be sidelined this week while he recovers from a back issue of some kind. His absence will leave Philadelphia's defensive front weaker than usual in a matchup against the Steelers this week.
items.title: Zack Baun (back) sidelined for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Hjalte Froholdt is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Froholdt will be good to go after clearing concussion protocol.
items.title: Hjalte Froholdt (concussion) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carson Beck is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Beck is dealing with a back injury. His status is uncertain for Sunday's game.
items.title: Carson Beck (back) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Wicks has been ruled out for another game on Sunday. He's still recovering from a pair of injuries, and although he seems to be improving, he's not yet where he needs to be to make his return to the lineup. His next chance to play will come on Thanksgiving Day against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) ruled out for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Sweat is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Sweat returned to full practices on Thursday and Friday. He will be good to go on Sunday.
items.title: Josh Sweat (shoulder/rest) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Walter Nolen III is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Nolen returned to full practices on Thursday and Friday. He will be good to go on Sunday.
items.title: Walter Nolen III (illness) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Will Shipley (foot/illness) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: The team recently opened the 21-day practice window for Shipley, and he may be back in the lineup on Sunday, as he is currently considered questionable to play. His path to play is now more complicated thanks to an illness that he picked up, and fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to have a big role even if he's fully cleared to make his return this week.
items.title: Will Shipley (foot/illness) questionable for Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Smith will be back in the lineup on Sunday after missing some time with a hamstring injury. His presence should be a nice boost for Philadelphia's offense moving forward, but he himself will likely be an inconsistent fantasy option with Joe Milton III currently the starting quarterback for the Eagles.
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) good to go for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carnell Tate is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Cowboys.
items.impact: Tate was able to practice all week, including a full practice on Friday. He is trending towards returning on Sunday.
items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) is set to play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran wideout will be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on Jacksonville's injury report throughout the week with an ankle issue. Meyers will continue to play his usual role in Week 11 and beyond.
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) set to play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyjae Spears is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Spears finished the week with a full practice on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Antonio Johnson (ankle) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Johnson is without an injury designation heading into the weekend, meaning his ankle injury isn't much more than a minor issue at this point. He will continue to play a key role in Jacksonville's secondary moving forward.
items.title: Antonio Johnson (ankle) without injury designation for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tony Pollard is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Pollard got a rest day from practice on Thursday. He will remain an RB2 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Tony Pollard off injury report Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) will play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Allen is going to be available to play on Sunday, which shouldn't come as a surprise to fantasy managers. He won't see enough work to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) will play Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Rodriguez is set to play on Sunday, despite managing a hand issue at practice throughout the week. He will continue to play second fiddle in this backfield behind Bhayshul Tuten for the foreseeable future.
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) off injury report for Sunday

title: Fantasy Player News
